purpose: Diagnostic comparison of current inputs with a retained pre-revision snapshot whose task IDs match the frozen paper selection.
scope: This is provenance metadata, not an executable subset pack. The official current benchmark denominator remains 1000.
The retained snapshot does not prove which working-tree bytes were executed for historical results.
Equal input JSON does not establish equal rendered observations, model weights, serving settings or episode histories.
For iTHOR, scene equality compares the episode scene configuration, not separately installed simulator assets.
JSON digests use UTF-8 json.dumps with sorted keys, compact separators, ensure_ascii=False and allow_nan=False.
